summary: SIEM feed c004_nic is degraded due to 1.80% packet loss at the tool (210,060 discards on SIEM eth1). Physical link is healthy, but SIEM capture interface cannot keep up, causing incomplete visibility.

findings.root_cause: SIEM eth1 is discarding packets it has already received because its 1Gbps capture interface/pipeline cannot keep up with the offered load from the packet broker (210,060 discards, 1.80% loss vs 0.1% threshold). Link error checks are healthy, so this is tool-side oversubscription/capture exhaustion, not cabling or optics.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM loses ~1.8% of packets before analysis, creating blind spots for correlation and detection. Events/alerts will be incomplete or missed, reducing detection coverage despite healthy TAP/SPAN path.

params.suggested_action: upgrade to 10Gbps capture or tune capture buffers and add broker-side filtering/slicing to fit 1Gbps

recommended_fix.why: Discards at the tool NIC mean the broker is delivering more traffic (pps/bps) than the 1G SIEM can ingest. Increasing tool ingest capacity and/or reducing load at the packet broker via filtering to SIEM-relevant traffic only or load-balancing will eliminate drops and restore complete SIEM visibility.
